decision.explanation: The 1978 college football season is described in the original sources as being part of both the NCAA Division I-A and NCAA Division III. Document D1S1 explicitly states that the 1978 NCAA Division I-A football season was the first season of Division I-A football, confirming its existence. Document D3S1 describes the 1978 NCAA Division III football season, indicating it was also active during the same year. These are distinct divisions within the NCAA structure and refer to separate levels of competition. Both are valid answers based on the provided sources.
